punchline: A four-star admiral's first advice for changing the world was to make your bed.
thirty_sec: In his 2014 commencement speech at the University of Texas, Admiral William McRaven said: if you want to change the world, start by making your bed. In SEAL training, instructors inspected every bed each morning. McRaven learned that finishing that first small task gives you a bit of pride and momentum for the next. And on a miserable day, you come home to a bed you made, a small sign tomorrow can be better.
